Re: Witches Brook Water Company proposed rate increase I believe the proposed 95.22 percent rate increase by Witches Brook Water Company is highly unreasonable. Such an increase would result in hardship for working families, especially in these difficult economic times. The residents do not have alternative water supply and are at the mercy of the water company. I urge the Department to determine the validity of the proposal and revise the rates accordingly. Diane M. Barletta
